sb.name: Purple Dragon Companion
sb.languages: understands the languages you know; telepathy 30 ft.

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 4 plus four times your Fighter level (the dragon has a number of Hit Dice [d6s] equal to your Fighter level)

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The dragon can breathe both air and water.

traits.name: Stalwart Bond
traits.desc: Add half your Proficiency Bonus (round down) to any ability check or saving throw the dragon makes.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3 plus your Intelligence modifier, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d6 plus your Intelligence modifier Force damage.

actions.name: Gravity Breath (2/Day)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 8 plus your Proficiency Bonus plus your Intelligence modifier, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: The target is either pulled up to 15 feet straight toward the dragon or pushed 15 feet straight away from the dragon (your choice).
